_comment: Pins RFC-MACP-0002 Section 6.1 (and RFC-MACP-0012 Section 6.4): mode validation runs before policy evaluation, so a message that breaches both a mode rule and a policy rule is rejected with the mode-rule code. Message 2 breaches both; message 3 is the control, showing the bound policy really does deny this tally on its own.
description: Core error mapping: a Commitment breaching both sender authorization and policy is FORBIDDEN, not POLICY_DENIED.

policy.description: Unanimous vote, initiator-only commitment, schema_version 3: an empty tally denies a positive commitment.

messages._comment: Breaches both rules: agent://a is not the commitment authority (a sender-authorization rule, FORBIDDEN), and the tally is empty, which schema_version 3 'unanimous' denies (POLICY_DENIED). The mode-rule code wins.
Control: the authorized initiator sends the same positive Commitment on the same empty tally. It passes mode validation, so policy evaluation runs and denies it.
